target: Spoiler-free complete play: all missions, ranks, characters, costumes, weapon sets, skills, medals, and Duo requirements

areas.name: Nintendo 3DS Route and Controls
areas.location_cue: The HOME Menu, title screen, Options, and an unused local save slot.
areas.note: The cartridge and former eShop release contain the same completion content.

levels.1: The selected route preserves the intended dual-screen controls.
levels.2: Launch the original Nintendo 3DS cartridge or an owned digital installation.
levels.3: Install the latest system update, start the game, create its local save, and confirm Mission, Character, Skill, and Duo menus all open normally.

levels.1: Reliable aiming and quick inventory changes are essential for high ranks.
levels.2: Choose a control type, then test movement, aiming, reloading, healing, and touch-screen item selection.
levels.3: Enter Mission 1-1, collect several markers while turning and quick-turning, switch weapons with the directional controls, touch an explosive slot, and restart if any input is unreliable.

levels.1: Several medals require a second participant and partner actions.
levels.2: Connect a second 3DS through Local Play or a currently functioning online route.
levels.3: Host a low-level mission, join from the second system, verify both players can revive and chain partner melees, then finish once so the profile stores a Duo result.

levels.1: Long medal and skill totals deserve a recovery copy.
levels.2: Back up the owned digital save or preserve the cartridge profile before serious progress.
levels.3: Close the software from the HOME Menu, use supported system backup tools where available, relaunch the game, and confirm the untouched profile still loads.

areas.name: Mission Level 1
areas.location_cue: Mission Select stages spanning compact arenas with fixed timers and enemy sets.
areas.note: Store SS on every listed mission; lower-rank unlocks are claimed automatically along the way.

levels.1: Use the map's time objects and a continuous chain to raise the stored result.
levels.2: On Public Assembly, collect twenty ordered markers and finish with an SS rank.
levels.3: Select Mission 1-1 and complete its collect twenty ordered markers objective. Follow only the currently glowing marker and use vaults, ladders, and the quick turn to avoid doubling back. Finish with enough remaining time and combo value for SS, then verify SS is stored on Mission Select.

areas.name: Shared Weapon Sets
areas.location_cue: Weapon Select after mission ranks or Nintendo 3DS Play Coin spending.
areas.note: Gameplay unlocks and Play Coins are equivalent routes; completing both is unnecessary.

levels.1: A full character-specific rank pass makes one loadout universally selectable.
levels.2: Earn A or better on every non-EX mission with the matching character, or spend 10 Play Coins.
levels.3: Use the matching character on all 21 missions from Levels 1 through 5 and store A or higher in each, then open Weapon Select and assign the newly shared set to a different character. The 10-Play-Coin shortcut reaches the same unlock.
